purpose: Move one concrete community problem from evidence to an accountable pilot proposal without hiding authority, adverse-use boundaries, fallback, closure, or handoff.

first_view.promise: One real problem. One accountable owner. One bounded promise.

working_surfaces.job: Combine resident knowledge, public records, maps, and hazard sources while showing what is missing, stale, or held.
Keep sources, decisions, holds, actions, receipts, and handoff in one record another person can reopen.
Coordinate tools, people, transport, funding, place knowledge, and continuity without merging who controls them.
working_surfaces.capacity_visualization: six named resource types without fabricated quantities

working_surfaces.job: Keep claims honest when a live provider fails and show each participant only the view needed for the job.

pilot_gates.requirement: case type plus a concrete statement of who is affected, what is failing, and what outcome would count
a named person or organizational role that accepts accountability and stop authority
a named and funded day-to-day operating role
venue, participants, resources, lawful access, and partners

pilot_gates.public_label: what is allowed and what stops the pilot
pilot_gates.requirement: permitted actions, prohibited consequences, and an explicit stop condition

invariants: Evidence and preparation do not grant access, spend, work, publication, representation, or release authority.
Assistance and place evidence may not become risk, eligibility, enforcement, resident, property, or other adverse standing.
Sources, decisions, holds, receipts, and handoffs must remain legible after the original person leaves.

visual_contract.mobile_case_layout: two columns at 390 CSS pixels; one column at 360 CSS pixels and below
visual_contract.mobile_duplicate_gate_map: hidden while preparation status remains visible
visual_contract.anchor_clearance: sticky desktop header may not occlude section headings
